map.根据鱼体均重、水温、品种与存塘量，计算日投喂率、日投喂量、建议投喂次数与饲料粒径: From average fish weight, water temperature, species and standing stock, computes the daily feeding rate, daily feed amount, recommended feeding frequency and pellet size.
map.养殖者按存塘量与水温制定每日投喂量，避免过量败坏水质或不足影响生长。: Farmers set daily feed amounts from standing stock and water temperature to avoid overfeeding that spoils water quality or underfeeding that slows growth.
map.不同生长阶段（鱼种/成鱼）切换饲料粒径与投喂频率。: Switch pellet size and feeding frequency across growth stages (fingerling/adult fish).
map.夏季高温与春季低温的投喂率差异管理，减少浪费与水质压力。: Manage the feeding-rate difference between hot summers and cool springs to reduce waste and water-quality pressure.
map.以 1000 kg 草鱼、水温 25℃、均重 200 g 估算日投喂: Estimate daily feeding for 1000 kg of grass carp at 25 °C and 200 g average weight
map.：水温 25℃ 处于适温区间，草鱼投喂率约 2.5%~3%；日投喂量 = 100: : Water temperature 25 °C is within the optimal range, giving a grass carp feeding rate of about 2.5%-3%; daily feed amount = 1000 kg x 3% = 30 kg. Split into 3-4 feedings (morning, noon, evening), with pellet size 3-4 mm chosen by mouth gape; if the water temperature drops below 15 °C, the feeding rate should fall below 1% and the frequency be reduced.
map.水温变化怎么调整投喂率？: How to adjust the feeding rate as water temperature changes?
map.多数温水性鱼类在 20~30℃ 摄食旺盛，投喂率取 2%~4%；低于 15℃ 消: Most warm-water fish feed actively at 20-30 °C with a feeding rate of 2%-4%; below 15 °C digestion declines and the rate should drop to about 1% or to feeding every other day; below 10 °C most species stop feeding. Reduce or suspend feeding on rainy days and before or after oxygen depletion.
map.饲料粒径怎么选？: How to choose feed pellet size?
map.粒径以鱼体口裂能顺利吞咽为准，一般约为鱼体体长的 1/4~1/3 或依品种规格表: Pellet size should be what the fish can swallow comfortably, generally about 1/4 to 1/3 of body length or according to the species specification table (for example grass carp: 1.5-2 mm at 50 g, 3-4 mm at 200 g, 4-5 mm at 500 g). Oversized pellets are hard to swallow while undersized ones create dust and waste, so move up a grade as the fish grow.
